name: Query API
description:
The Query API lets you query Sanity Content Lake with GROQ.

You can also send queries to the CDN endpoint for edge-cached results:
https://{projectId}.apicdn.sanity.io/v{YYYY-MM-DD}/data/query/{dataset}

The CDN only serves the `published` and `raw` perspectives. Send queries that use drafts or release perspectives to the API endpoint.

While you can use the HTTP API endpoint directly, we recommend using a client library if you can.
